action.instructions: Which action is explicitly requested by the user? If no action is requested, choose none.

criteria.approach: Walk closer. Come here. Come closer to me. Approach me.
criteria.stepback: Move away. Step back. Go back. Give me space. Keep your distance.
criteria.wave: Wave your hand. Wave hello. Greet me with a wave.
criteria.comfort: Comfort me. Reassure me. I feel sad, anxious, lonely or overwhelmed.
criteria.none: Ordinary conversation. Asking a question. No action. Do not move.
criteria.sit: Sit down. Sit with me on the sofa. Let us sit together on the couch.
criteria.stand: Stand up from the sofa. Get up. Leave the seat.
criteria.beside: Stand beside me. Stand next to me. Stay by my side.
criteria.pour: Pour the wine. Pour a drink. Fill the glass.
criteria.drink: Raise a glass. Have a drink. Cheers.
criteria.sing: Sing. Take the microphone. Start the song.

speech.instructions: When should her spoken reply play relative to the action?

criteria.speak: Ordinary conversation or a question. Say the reply. If she also moves, say it first.
criteria.after: The visitor asked her to come, sit, stand, pour, drink, sing, or step back. Move first, then speak.
criteria.before: A greeting, a wave, or comfort. Speak first, then the small gesture.
criteria.silent: The visitor asked her not to talk, to be quiet, or to stop speaking.
